title: One Hero, Enchanted Blade
notes: No more class choice at the start: you begin as a Breaker with a plain steel blade and your own skills (Quick Cut, Whirlwind, Second Wind, Blade Storm).
Weapon Enchant (unlocks at Floor 5): give your blade Flame, Storm, Void or Blood. Each element brings its own skills and colors and stays on every weapon you equip.
Enchant levels 1 to 5: each level adds +12% Skill DMG. Switching the element later is possible.
New currency: Rift Diamonds. Earned from first clears of boss and elite floors, Deep Floor bosses, Arena wins, Rank Exams, the Crystal Mine and rare drops.
Clearer currencies: Gold, Mana Stones and Diamonds are bigger and labelled at the top.
Upgrades show big cost lines with what you have and what you need. Item details are larger and easier to read.
Balanced for a longer journey: about 3 to 4 hours to reach Rank B (measured with test playthroughs).
Older saves keep their chosen power as a level 1 enchantment.
